Standoff Robotics · LONGWALK SR-4 Tracked explosive ordnance disposal robot Fig. 00

Remote EOD. Operator at 300 m.

LONGWALK SR-4 approaches, inspects and disrupts explosive devices under remote control. The operator stays at the control point: up to 300 m by fibre tether, 1.2 km by radio.

    Field demonstration

    Three days at your range. One SR-4 and one field engineer. Your operators, your scenarios, your written assessment.

    2. Operator-led trials on your course.
    3. Assessment scenarios. Written report issued on site.
